name: Traded Instrument PNL
description: Retrieves the real-time Profit and Loss (PNL) of a specific instrument that has already been traded. Commonly used for trailing stop loss logic.

parameters.name: Set Number
parameters.description: The Set number of the trade.

parameters.name: Leg Number
parameters.description: The specific leg number to calculate PNL for.

usage_example: Traded Instrument PNL(Underlying: BankNifty, Set Number: 1, Condition Number: 1, Leg Number: 2) < -500
